info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Drafts Retrieval API
info.description: The Bank Drafts Retrieval API enables users to access and retrieve information about bank drafts within the consumer banking services. This endpoint serves financial institutions, developers, and applications requiring up-to-date bank draft details, helping them streamline customer interactions and manage banking operations effectively. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their service offerings and provide users with transparent access to important financial documents. Typical use cases include integrating bank draft information into customer portals or financial management tools.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of bank drafts associated with consumer services. You can use this to check the status or other relevant information about bank drafts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve bank drafts related to consumer services. Ensure that the provided parameters match the expected schema for successful retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of bank drafts.
